_comment: Operating / modelling assumptions for the dispatch optimization.
_apply_intraday_load_shape_note: The metered data is daily-resolution (one value per day spread across 24 h). When true, a generic farm intraday shape is applied while preserving daily energy; when false the flat daily value is kept (honest to the source data).

monthly_kwh_calibration._note: Actual billed kWh per calendar month from the Centre Wellington Hydro Customer Activity Statement (avg of available years). Each month of the hourly profile is scaled to match. Set to null to use the raw metered profile.
